Summary: local-main-drift sensor silently no-ops when ORCH_NOTIFY_TICKET is unset
Description: Finding: check_local_main_drift() (scripts/orchestrator.sh:7660-7678), the ABS-224 AC3/PILOT-3 detection path for commits slipped onto local main, is repo-scoped and so calls notify "${ORCH_NOTIFY_TICKET:-}". ORCH_NOTIFY_TICKET defaults to empty (:646) and notify() fail-opens on an empty ticket (:6796). In the DEFAULT configuration the alert degrades to a run.log line and the run stays green. It is the only notify call site with neither a ticket fallback nor push compensation: 19 sites use ${ORCH_NOTIFY_TICKET:-$ticket} (e.g. check_claim_protocol :7700); the two other ticket-less sites (pause_for_daily_budget :8208, pause_for_budget :8222) compensate via budget_pause_push (ABS-455 AC1). || Repro: leave ORCH_NOTIFY_TICKET unset; create a commit on local main not on the active remote; run the orchestrator; observe INTENT-LOCAL-MAIN-DRIFT immediately followed by 'notify skipped (no notify ticket)' -- no tracker comment, no push, no non-zero exit. Live: v2.35.0 consumer, 2026-07-29, fired on two sweeps (16:16:56, 16:20:13) and was discarded both times while an accepted epic's entire deliverable (50 files, 630 insertions, incl. a poetry.lock carrying 3 CVE fixes) sat uncommitted and 3 commits sat unpushed; found only by a retro seat running git status by hand. || Fix: (1) route the ticket-less drift alert through the existing budget_pause_push channel (ABS-455 AC1), or generalise it to an ops_push <body> helper shared with the budget pauses; (2) never let a repo-scoped alert silently no-op -- surface the verdict in the run summary, as the existing INTENT row demonstrably is not enough; (3) diagnosability: name the remote resolution source in the drift line (remote=origin/main (source=branch.main.remote)), since resolve_active_main_ref has a 5-step chain ending in a hardcoded origin -- here a clone-set branch.main.remote made it report ahead=11 against a remote the project does not push to (true drift against the real target: 3). || Fork: none -- no boilerplate-owned file modified locally (ADR-A-0008).

Summary: security-audit skill advertises stack-agnostically but is TS/Prisma/RLS-only
Description: Finding: .claude/skills/security-audit/SKILL.md (harness source harness/claude/skills/security-audit/) has a frontmatter description ending '...or scanning for security issues', matching security work in ANY project, while its body is exclusively TypeScript/Prisma/Next.js/Supabase-RLS: 207 lines; 2 typescript code blocks and 0 python; 23 mentions of Prisma/RLS/Supabase/Next.js and 0 of bandit/pip-audit/FastAPI/SQLModel/Poetry. Normative sections assert stack-specific rules with no off-stack referent (FORBIDDEN prisma.user.findMany(); CORRECT withUserContext(prisma, userId, ...)). On a Python consumer the skill loads on its broad description and supplies confident, inapplicable guidance -- a missing skill leaves a visible gap, a present and wrong one leaves a plausible gap. || Repro: adopt the boilerplate in a non-TS project (here Python 3.13/FastAPI/SQLModel/Poetry); run any task matching 'vulnerability scanning' or 'pre-deployment security review'; the skill matches on description and addresses an absent stack. Live: v2.35.0 consumer, 2026-07-29 -- a 9-story security epic (4 CVE remediations + 5 bandit rule-category triage passes, 107 findings) ran entirely inside the skill's advertised trigger surface and drew nothing from it. || Fix: (1) narrow the frontmatter description -- drop the stack-agnostic tail, name the stack ('...for Next.js/Prisma/Supabase projects'); (2) rename to security-audit-prisma-rls so name and description both carry the stack; (3) split into a stack-agnostic core (OWASP checklist, secret-exposure scan, auth-on-route review) plus stack-specific companions -- the only option leaving non-TS consumers something usable. (1)/(2) are worth doing independently of (3). If harness/claude/skills/ is edited, regenerate the agent_providers/claude_code/ mirror in the same commit (bash scripts/generate-governor.sh --providers). || Fork: none -- boilerplate-owned skill file not modified locally (ADR-A-0008).
